facts.text: Mercyhurst operates the Autism Initiative at Mercyhurst (AIM) to support college students on the autism spectrum in all domains of college life.

sources.title: Autism Initiative at Mercyhurst (AIM)
sources.quote: The mission of the Autism Initiative at Mercyhurst (AIM) is to facilitate and support the successful adjustment and progression of college students on the autism spectrum in all domains of college life
